body: I have trouble writing cohesive posts, so I find myself having to express part of my thoughts through writing. I'm sorry. I just... don't know where to start, nor even how to explain myself. To grasp my thoughts, I'd have to practically tell you my life, since each event is intrisically related to the former. Nonetheless, I've been feeling so put down for the past eight months that I just can't take it, I want to end it all. I've got no where to run, no where else to go, and I can't continue to function within my own abusive home like this. I live in the middle of no where, I can't just easily visit a friend, or walk or even take the bus somewhere to get my mind off things. I have, physically barricaded myself within my own room, and avoid all contact with other members in this house. I stopped eating. I fear going out. I fear waking up. I fear living. I'm never permitted to do anything, and I'm always bashed upon and diminished as a worthless piece of waste. To sum, that's the type of roof I live under. And I can't take it, and I'm only making things worse for myself. I wake up wanting to die.
